recommendation: Keep this narrow source fix. It corrects the misleading invariant display text while leaving the already-applied terminology, narrative, and app-2 behavior intact; any future waitlist relationship guidance should proceed under FHIR-54399 or a later final decision.
issue_request: FHIR-18824 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and requested adding a waitlist concept to Appointment.status, defining it, permitting waitlisted appointments to omit start/end through app-3, and adding waitlist narrative.
initial_application: GF#18824 commits 29089ed28e and 7fab7533d1 added the waitlist status source and waitlist narrative. Current source already had waitlist in the Appointment status CodeSystem, the required ValueSet include, Appointment.status short text, the app-3 expression, and waitlist workflow narrative; the remaining gap was the stale app-3 human text.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Appointment as an active resource. 2018 PA WGM minutes confirm the approved scope was to add the waitlist status and update the appointment state table and invariant, without adding broader waitlist structures. Later FHIR-37515 supports preserving app-2's separate start/end pairing rule, FHIR-54225 found the current waitlist-flow narrative sufficient, and FHIR-54399 remains a later triaged request for future waitlist relationship guidance.
reconciliation: Updated source/appointment/structuredefinition-Appointment.xml so app-3 says proposed, cancelled, or waitlisted appointments can be missing start/end dates, matching the existing expression that permits status='waitlist'.
source_changes: source/appointment/structuredefinition-Appointment.xml: changed app-3 human text from only proposed/cancelled to proposed, cancelled, or waitlisted appointments.

related_jiras.note: Earlier proposed-versus-waitlisted Appointment request was resolved as covered by FHIR-18824.
Later no-change decision explains why app-2 still requires start and end to be present together, distinct from app-3's status-based allowance.
Later no-change ballot issue found the current waitlist-flow narrative sufficient for clarification purposes.
Later triaged request concerns additional waitlist relationship guidance or extension support and is not final applied scope for this reconciliation.
